I’d rather search stay within the view I’m in. In particular, archived bookmarks should not reappear in an ordinary search; I should search them deliberately from the Archived view. The same approach for “To read” and “Done” would make the results predictable.

Clicking a tag to filter by that exact tag feels right. The text search should cover the full link and description as well as the title and note, and it should ignore capitalisation.

For more precise searches, I’d also like to type `#tag` for a tag, put an exact phrase in quotation marks, and combine terms with AND, OR, NOT, and parentheses—for example, `rome (#article OR #book)`. A tag condition and ordinary words should both have to match when used together.
